title: Choose Gamepad
question: Three compositions in the existing HUD world. Same job: glance which buttons and sticks are live. DualShock vs Xbox glyphs switch with the pad. No pad is a small No controller plaque, not an empty DualShock.

options.label: Glass
options.thesis: The DualShock fills the night-ink plaque. Orange is the press. Sticks physically leave their wells.
options.viewport: Wide plaque. Full DualShock 4 top-down, charcoal body, no space art. Cross filled orange. Left stick kicked up-left with an orange halo. R2 analog fill. Xbox pads get the same body language with ABXY.
options.risk: A full pad can read as a toy instead of a race graphic if the body gets busy.

options.label: Cluster
options.thesis: No grips. Four input wells across the glass — D-pad, left stick, right stick, face — plus L2/R2 tracks on top.
options.viewport: Wide shorter plaque. No controller body. Right on the D-pad and Cross on the diamond are orange fills. Left stick disc is offset in its well. Thin L2/R2 tracks along the top edge, R2 ~70% orange.
options.risk: Without the DualShock silhouette it may not feel like the photo you brought.

options.label: Tracks
options.thesis: A small live pad plus Systems-family analog tracks. Magnitude as numbers, presses as orange glyphs.
options.viewport: Portrait plaque, hairline split. Top: compact DualShock with orange Cross and offset left stick. Bottom: LX LY RX RY LT RT tracks with orange fills and percents.
options.risk: Glance may require reading numbers. The stick-follows-hand moment is smaller.
